segments.english: Unit 7. Open day. Words and expressions.
The Open Day is on the 30th of April.
Ms. Gwar is asking the children about the day.
Children, your parents will come to our school at 2 o'clock in the
I'll meet them at the school gate.
What will they do first? Can you tell me?
That's right. What will they do next?
Next, they'll visit the art room.
Then, they'll go to the hall.
After that, they'll go to the library.
Finally, they'll meet the teachers in the meeting room.
1. It is 2 o'clock in the afternoon.
Ms. Gwar welcomes the parents at the school gate.
2. First, Ms. Gwar takes the parents to the classroom.
She tells them about the lessons.
3. Next, they go to the art room.
The children show their parents some beautiful pictures.
4. Then they go to the hall.
The children sing for their parents.
5. After that, they go to the library.
They look at the homework and projects on the board.
